title: Section III. Of the Association of Ideas
author: David Hume
summary: Ideas are joined in the mind by only three principles of connexion: resemblance, contiguity in time or place, and cause or effect.

notes.on: a principle of connexion between the different thoughts
notes.note: In the editions before 1777 this section went on to a long discussion of how the association of ideas gives unity to epic poetry and drama, which Hume cut.
